Collective boundary kernels can fuse residual, norm, or next-layer preparation; they remain named handoffs rather than pure communication time.
Implementation-provider leaves are symbol-derived; model ownership comes from the repeated anchor and two-handoff motif.
MFU, MBU, FLOPs, and useful-byte estimates remain null pending separately reviewed GB300-local evidence.
This tree does not establish which output token, if any, owns the selected replay; inspect graph_generation_audit.json for the entire two-replay request.
kernel_family_index is a secondary non-owning aggregation for sweep joins; it is not an additional child of kernel_tree and therefore does not duplicate event ownership.
Semantic owner coverage is broader than standalone comparison eligibility; only exact B=100 raw-name/configuration matches may inherit the standalone work model.
Neither Nsight Systems SQLite exports a cubin SHA-256; the comparison records exact raw-name hashes/configurations and relies on experiment image/source provenance for binary identity.
